$comment: Exact provider CLI versions installed by .github/workflows/deploy.yml before any deploy:* or db:* script runs. scripts/deploy/provider-clis.ts refuses a CLI whose --version does not match. Bump deliberately, in one reviewed change, together with the setup-cli action SHA in deploy.yml.

vercel.install: npm install -g vercel@<version> (deploy.yml step 'Install Vercel CLI (pinned)')

supabase.install: supabase/setup-cli pinned by commit SHA in deploy.yml with version: <version>
